questions.text: How long has Stepnoy Corner been open?
questions.hint: "It opened six months ago."

questions.text: Gulnaz learned to cook from her mother.
questions.hint: "learned to cook from her grandmother"

questions.text: What is the national dish of Kazakhstan?
questions.hint: "This is the national dish of Kazakhstan."

questions.text: The vegetarian manty is filled with pumpkin and ___.
questions.hint: "a vegetarian version filled with pumpkin and potato"

questions.text: How much is the daily set lunch?
questions.hint: "The daily set lunch... is just 1,800 tenge."

questions.text: The café uses artificial flavourings in its drinks.
questions.hint: "no artificial flavourings or preservatives in anything on the menu"

questions.text: What does Kamila order as her starter?
questions.hint: "I'll have a small bowl of soup as a starter, please."

questions.text: Zhibek orders a freshly squeezed watermelon juice.
questions.hint: "I'd love the fresh watermelon juice."

questions.text: Why is Rustam at the market in Dialogue 2?
opts: To make a salad for Zhibek's birthday
questions.correct: To make a salad for Zhibek's birthday
questions.hint: "I promised Zhibek I'd make a salad for her birthday dinner."

questions.text: What does Rustam forget to buy at the first stall?
questions.hint: "Rustam — you forgot the cheese and olive oil!"

questions.text: Rustam pays 1,500 tenge for items totalling 1,470 tenge and says "Keep the ___".
questions.hint: "Keep the change" = the seller can keep the extra 30 tenge.

questions.text: The seller at the market has fresh basil.
questions.hint: "No basil today, I'm afraid."

questions.text: "Rice" is ___ noun.
questions.hint: Rice cannot be counted: "a rice" ❌ → uncountable.

questions.text: How ___ tomatoes should I buy for the salad?
questions.hint: Tomatoes = countable → How many tomatoes?

questions.text: How ___ water do you drink per day?
questions.hint: Water = uncountable → How much water?

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.hint: "some bread" ✅ — uncountable, positive statement → some.

questions.text: "Is there ___ milk in the fridge?"
questions.hint: Question → "any": Is there any milk? ✅

questions.text: "I don't have some eggs" is correct.
questions.hint: Negatives → "any": I don't have any eggs. ✅

questions.text: "Would you like ___ soup?" — polite offer.
questions.hint: Offers → "some": Would you like some soup? ✅

questions.text: "She added ___ sugar — just a small amount."
questions.hint: Sugar = uncountable, small amount = a little sugar.

questions.text: "There are ___ cafés here — only one."
questions.hint: "few" (without "a") = almost none, negative/disappointing feeling.

questions.text: I drank three ___ of water after the football match.
questions.hint: Water is uncountable → use a partitive: three glasses of water.

questions.text: "Too ___ salt!" — the soup is terrible.
questions.hint: Salt = uncountable → too much salt.

questions.text: "___ of food" — works with countable AND uncountable.
questions.hint: "a lot of" works with both: a lot of apples ✅ · a lot of milk ✅.

questions.text: What does "cuisine" mean?
opts: The style of cooking typical of a country
questions.correct: The style of cooking typical of a country
questions.hint: Cuisine = the cooking style of a country or region.

questions.text: The café uses only fresh, locally ___ ingredients.
questions.hint: "Locally sourced" = obtained from local farms and producers.

questions.text: What is a "starter" in a restaurant?
opts: A small dish served before the main course
questions.correct: A small dish served before the main course
questions.hint: Starter = appetiser — served first, before the main dish.

questions.text: "Refreshing" means making you feel tired.
questions.hint: Refreshing = making you feel cool and energetic. The opposite of tired.

questions.text: What does "ripe" mean?
opts: Fully grown and ready to eat
questions.correct: Fully grown and ready to eat
questions.hint: Ripe = at the perfect stage of growth for eating.

questions.text: "A portion" of food means...
opts: The amount of food given to one person
questions.correct: The amount of food given to one person
questions.hint: Portion = serving size; the amount given to one person.
